title: Volley Wave File
description: A wave definition submitted to a supervisor (volleyd run <wave.yaml>). Authored as YAML; this schema validates the parsed document. Not an envelope. Structural rules a schema cannot express (every after target names a task in this file; the after graph is acyclic; task ids are unique) are enforced by the supervisor's parser, which reports them with the same path-qualified errors. See spec section 4.6.

wave.description: Wave id (spec section 2.1 grammar); appears as a topic segment in volley/_waves/<wave>/*.

version.description: Wave file version; bumped on a versioned re-submission.

repo.description: Repository the wave's tasks work in: a path to the supervisor's clone, or a GitHub owner/name, resolved at submit to the supervisor's clone of it when its machine holds one (config repos, hosts.<name>.repos, fleet.repo_root; spec section 4.6.4); when only paired machines hold it the wave keeps the owner/name and its tasks are placed on those machines (a task pinned to host: local is refused); an owner/name no machine holds is refused. A relative path shaped like owner/name is written ./owner/name. Must not start with '-', so it can never be read as a command-line option.

release_branch.description: Branch the wave's worktrees are cut from and its PRs target. A git ref name: no leading '-' (never read as an option), no whitespace or ~^:?*[\.

model.description: Default model for every agent in the wave. One word as /model and claude --model take it (e.g. claude-opus-5-5, opus, claude-x[1m], us.anthropic.claude-x-v1:0): the authority fence's MODEL_ID.

namespace.description: Volley namespace the wave's agents register in (default: the supervisor's).

heavy_pools.description: Lease pools (config lease_pools keys) this wave's heavy operations draw from.

playbook.description: The repository's release playbook (spec section 4.6.19): a path relative to repo, or absolute, or none (the wave has no release train). Absent: .volley/release.yaml in repo, when it exists.

merge.description: Who merges a gated PR (spec section 4.6.17): auto (the supervisor squash-merges exactly the gated head) or manual (a human merges). Absent: the supervisor's autopilot.merge tunable (default auto).

placement.description: auto: the supervisor places every task without a host of its own across the eligible machines (spec section 4.6.15). local: those tasks run on the supervisor's own host.

placement_prefer.description: Host names placement ranks first among eligible machines.

placement_avoid.description: Host names placement uses only when no other machine is eligible.

spawn_budget.description: Maximum agent spawns for the wave (retries and reviewers included); default: every task's pipeline roles plus retry headroom, or spawn_budget_multiplier x task count when that is more.

config.description: Per-wave overrides of the supervisor tunables, layered over the global config.

account.description: The Claude account (spec section 4.6.11) every agent of the wave runs under: an id from the supervisor's Claude account registry, primary (the default profile) or most_headroom. Default: the claude.default_account tunable, else primary.

brief_preface.description: The brief preface file (spec section 4.6.9): a path relative to repo, or absolute. Its bytes are prepended verbatim to every brief the supervisor writes for this wave. Default: .volley/brief-preface.md in the repo.

remoteHost.description: An inline remote host: agents run in tmux on another machine reached over SSH. Every key but type is optional here; layered over hosts.<name> from the supervisor config, the host must end up with target, repo and volley_dir. Its keywords apply to objects only, so host: <name> strings pass through it.

name.description: Host label (wave state, journal) and the hosts.<name> config entry layered under this one; default: the target.

pipeline.description: Ordered pipeline stages; a nested array is a group of stages that run in parallel.

after.description: Task ids that must reach done before this task may start.

host.description: Where the task's agents run: local (the supervisor's own host), auto (the supervisor places it, spec section 4.6.15), the name of a remote host in the supervisor config (hosts.<name>), or an inline remote host (layered over hosts.<name> when it names one). Absent: auto under a wave's placement: auto, else local (no static default, so a tool filling in defaults cannot pin a task to local under placement: auto).

account.description: The Claude account this task's agents run under; overrides the wave's account.

heavy.description: The task runs heavy operations: placement puts it only on a machine with a free per-machine slot in the wave's heavy_pools (spec section 4.6.15).

files.description: Scheduling hint: paths or globs the task is expected to touch; overlapping tasks are started later. It is also the task's footprint, the files the overlap plan reads.

issues.description: Every GitHub issue the task closes, when it bundles several; must contain issue.

footprint.description: How the task's files were found: listed (its issue lists them), resolved (bare names resolved against the tree), guessed (inferred), none (unknown). unresolved: the names that matched no path.

taskPlan.description: Where the overlap plan put the task: its cluster, how the cluster is run (collapse: bundled into one task; chain: after another; cap: a limit on the cluster's tasks in flight; independent: no overlap) and why.
